children: AIR Limited, a Dubai-headquartered dealer in shisha and tobacco products, has launched a US dollar-denominated Regulation S offering with the intention to issue senior unsecured notes that will be guaranteed by its parent company, AIR Global, which is listed on Nasdaq.

AIR Limited said proceeds from the debt issuance will be used to repay amounts outstanding term loan and revolving credit facilities, including any accrued and unpaid interest, premiums, fees and expenses payable in connection with such repayment. The rest of the funding will be deployed for general corporate purposes.
Details of mandated banks have not been disclosed.
Moody’s said it has assigned a Ba3 instrument rating to the proposed issuance, with an expected size of $400 million.

Founded in 1999, the company, formally known as Advanced Inhalation Rituals, is a wholly owned subsidiary of AIR Global, which retails Al Fakher, the flavoured shisha molasses brand, along with Crown Switch, a pod vaping platform.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Brinda Darasha)

title: Dubai shisha maker AIR to issue USD Reg S notes
